data.gender_notes: Salil is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Salil is derived from the Sanskrit word 'salila', which means 'flow of water'. This name is associated with calmness, peace, and the tranquil flow of water. It is a beautiful name for a baby boy, and is often given to children born during the rainy season. The name Salil carries the meaning “Flow of Water” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Salil usually hope their child will grow to embody flow of water and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Salil is a name that is deeply rooted in Hindu spirituality. It is believed that the name Salil carries the blessings of Lord Varuna, the Hindu deity of water. This name is also associated with the goddess Saraswati, who is the goddess of knowledge, learning, and wisdom. Parents who wish to give their child a name that is steeped in spiritual meaning and significance may consider the name Salil.
data.etymology: Salil belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Flow of Water.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Salil total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
